subject: Discovery recap + integration readiness / procurement queue check
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: Miguel Torres <m.torres@stratoshealth.com>, Dana Liu <dana.liu@stratoshealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap + integration readiness / procurement queue check

Hi Miguel / Dana —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

1) Integration scope: Redwood inference endpoint -> Stratos ingestion pipeline (low-latency routing, token budget ~20k/day for pilot). I attached a one-page integration map that highlights where KV cache and prefix caching live in the flow.

2) Security & compliance: you mentioned SOC2 docs + IP restrictions. We can surface a minimal evidence bundle for your procurement team — SOC2 report + network/IP allowlist guide.

3) Procurement handoff items (what your procurement team needs to unblock vendor setup):
   - Completed W-9 (PDF) from Stratos (upload to vendor portal or send to procurement@redwoodinference.com)
   - ACH details or PO instructions (your procurement), and a contact for the portal invite (name + email)

4) Pilot timeline: we recommended a 2–3 week sandbox trial after portal access to validate throughput.

Can you confirm who on your side owns the portal submission? If you already have a vendor portal link, drop it here and we’ll watch for the invite. If procurement prefers, we can also accept a signed SOW + W-9 and create the vendor record on your behalf (requires PO/ACH info). 

Attachments: stratos-integration-map.pdf (1 page)

Thanks — happy to jump on a 15-min sync if that helps move the portal step faster.

—
Logan Wright
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Miguel Torres <m.torres@stratoshealth.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>, Dana Liu <dana.liu@stratoshealth.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 15:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + integration readiness / procurement queue check

Thanks for the clear recap, Logan — helpful.

Short update from procurement side: we uploaded the W-9 you requested to our internal vendor intake (attached here for your record) and I asked our vendor onboarding team to send Redwood the portal invite. I quoted procurement: "portal invites are issued in 24–72 hours after W-9/ACH received."

Contacts: 
- Procurement lead: Dana Liu (CC'd)
- Vendor onboarding: procurement-onboard@stratoshealth.com (I copied them on the internal ticket)

We are prioritizing this for the pilot but if you want to keep momentum on your side, a quick sandbox token grant during setup would help us validate the integration before portal access is fully provisioned. Is that something Redwood can offer?

Attachment: stratos-w9.pdf (W-9)

—
Miguel Torres
Director, Integrations | Stratos Health
m.torres@stratoshealth.com | (415) 666-2200

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: Miguel Torres <m.torres@stratoshealth.com>, Dana Liu <dana.liu@stratoshealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 11:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + integration readiness / procurement queue check

Hey Miguel / Dana — bumping this thread since we haven't seen the vendor portal invite come through yet.

Appreciate you uploading the W-9 — I can confirm we received the copy and have it attached to the HubSpot deal record. Two quick asks to keep the pilot timeline from slipping: 

- Can you confirm whether procurement-onboard@stratoshealth.com has issued the portal invite? If not, we can take the SOW route (you send PO or ACH details to procurement@redwoodinference.com) and I will request immediate provisioning from our ops team.

- If procurement expects the 24–72 hour window, are we on day 3 already? If so, do you want me to introduce Ben Carter (cc'd) — our onboarding ops lead — to the procurement-onboard alias to expedite?

If it helps, we can also arrange a short triage call (10 min) today to align everyone and avoid a lost week for the pilot. What's your availability?

Attachment: (none)

—
Logan Wright
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Dana Liu <dana.liu@stratoshealth.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>, Miguel Torres <m.torres@stratoshealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 14:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + integration readiness / procurement queue check

Hi Logan — thanks for the ping and sorry for the delay. 

Quick update: our vendor onboarding queue was a bit backed up last week. I asked procurement-onboard@stratoshealth.com to prioritize Redwood and they just issued the portal invite to onboarding@redwoodinference.com (you should see an automated email from vendor-portal@stratoshealth.com). I attached a copy of the W-9 we uploaded for your records as well.

Next steps on our side: 
- Portal invite should arrive within the hour. Please accept the invite and complete the vendor profile (ACH/PO fields).
- Once you confirm profile completion, procurement will approve within 24 hours and we can kick off a sandbox window.

If you prefer me to loop Ben directly to confirm the portal fields we need populated, happy to do so — cc'd him.

Attachment: stratos-w9.pdf (uploaded copy)

Best,
Dana Liu
Procurement Lead | Stratos Health
